name: Incomplete or nonfunctional implementation
name_zh: 实现未完成或缺乏有效处理
definition: The supplied program lacks a completed task-solving path: its body is absent, its source is truncated, its general computation never returns a result, or it substitutes an input-independent placeholder for the requested behavior.
inclusion: Pass-only or documentation-only bodies; unfinished literals, expressions or blocks.
Repeated or partial statements without a completed computation and return.
Constant placeholder output with no substantive implementation of the task.
exclusion: A missing local operation in an otherwise substantive algorithm: C05.
An implemented calculation that solves a different problem: C04.
A missing symbol used by otherwise interpretable logic: C02; co-code only if lack of a completed result is separate.

name: Unavailable symbol or dependency
name_zh: 引用未提供的符号或依赖
definition: The supplied program requires a variable, helper, module or imported name that is not bound in the context provided with the artifact.
inclusion: Calls to undeclared helpers or unimported modules.
Misspelled or out-of-scope names needed for execution.
exclusion: A present object with an unsupported operation: C03.
An unfinished token in truncated source, without a separately established dependency: C01.
Do not assume an external execution harness supplies the missing name; state this context limit.

name: Incompatible operation or API use
name_zh: 操作与数据类型或 API 不匹配
definition: An operation, method or API is applied to an object or argument structure that cannot provide the intended behavior under Python's type and API semantics.
inclusion: Arithmetic on character strings, numeric objects treated as sequences, unsupported container methods.
Invalid argument or subscript types; list multiplication used where scalar arithmetic is required.
exclusion: An undeclared object or function: C02.
A valid operation with the wrong numeric formula: C09.
Domain-specific text or numeric representation conversion errors are C10 when that explains the failure without an additional API misuse.

name: Wrong computational target or unit of analysis
name_zh: 计算目标或处理单位偏离要求
definition: The implementation computes a different property, uses the wrong entities or aggregation level, or replaces the required relation with a non-equivalent proxy.
inclusion: Word length instead of consonant count; whole-number properties instead of digit properties; indices instead of values.
Whole-collection totals instead of per-group calculations; ordinary factorial instead of product of factorials.
Checking a different mathematical property, such as parity instead of primality.
exclusion: The intended quantity is computed with a wrong local formula: C09.
A correct target lacks one additional eligibility check: C05.
A recognizably correct predicate has an incorrect threshold or Boolean relation: C06.
A ranking objective alone is wrong: C11.

name: Omitted requirement or processing step
name_zh: 遗漏必要条件、分支或处理步骤
definition: A substantive implementation performs part of the requested task but leaves out a required condition, operation, branch or explicitly stated implementation constraint.
inclusion: Missing an eligibility filter, required transformation, alternate allowed mode, or part of a conjunction.
Implementing only some explicitly permitted cases; ignoring a stated no-recursion constraint.
Dropping the contribution of otherwise valid unmatched elements.
exclusion: The whole implementation is absent or a placeholder: C01.
An existing condition is wrong rather than absent: C06.
Prefer C07 for traversal coverage, C10 for representation-specific normalization, C11 for tie-breaking, and C13 for exceptional-input guards; do not add C05 again for the same omission.

name: Incorrect decision condition
name_zh: 判断条件、阈值或分支优先级错误
definition: A condition controlling eligibility, branching or result emission uses an incorrect relation, threshold, logical combination or precedence, although its intended decision can be identified.
inclusion: Strict versus inclusive comparisons, reversed predicates, tautologies and contradictions.
Unjustified restrictions and incorrect branch precedence.
Result emission guarded by a condition unrelated to when that result is required.
exclusion: An absent condition: C05, or C13 for exceptional-input handling.
A predicate for a fundamentally different property: C04.
A faulty state reset or recurrence: C08; traversal bounds: C07.

name: Incorrect traversal or positional coverage
name_zh: 遍历范围、位置或候选覆盖错误
definition: Iteration, indexing or candidate enumeration visits the wrong positions, omits required candidates, or accesses positions outside the applicable sequence bounds.
inclusion: Off-by-one endpoints, incorrect index parity, wrong scan direction or returned neighboring index.
Considering only adjacent or fixed candidates when arbitrary candidates are required.
Skipping overlapping matches or forbidding permitted revisits.
exclusion: Correctly visited values are ranked incorrectly: C11.
A failure restricted to an empty, zero-sized or short boundary input requiring a guard: C13.
Wrong loop state or nontermination: C08; wrong semantic object being traversed: C04.

name: Incorrect state evolution or termination
name_zh: 状态初始化、更新或终止错误
definition: Stateful or recursive computation uses incorrect seeds, updates, recurrence dependencies or stopping behavior, so intermediate state no longer represents the required computation.
inclusion: Wrong sequence bases, corrupted rolling state, future-state reads before initialization.
Recursion with no decreasing argument or unsuccessful-cycle termination.
Resetting a running aggregate on the wrong sign; losing associations when independently updating linked structures.
exclusion: A stateless formula error: C09.
An output-only container shape problem: C12.
Wrong loop index bounds without a state-evolution defect: C07.

name: Incorrect arithmetic or numerical treatment
name_zh: 算式、运算顺序或数值处理错误
definition: The intended quantity is recognizable, but its mathematical expression, numeric operator, rounding, precision treatment or operation order is wrong.
inclusion: Missing factors or roots, double counting, incorrect inclusion–exclusion formulas.
True division instead of integer digit extraction, wrong rounding convention, operator precedence ignored.
Numerical stopping or exactness assumptions that do not ensure the requested numeric result.
exclusion: Computing a different quantity altogether: C04.
Wrong recurrence dependencies or state updates: C08.
Wrong text encoding, sign representation or alphabet mapping: C10.
Do not infer numerical instability solely because floating-point arithmetic is used.

name: Incorrect representation or transformation
name_zh: 表示方式、解析或转换错误
definition: Parsing, normalization, encoding, decoding or symbolic transformation fails to preserve or implement the task's intended meaning.
inclusion: Wrong delimiters, numeral bases, signed-digit interpretation, character substitutions or case normalization.
Regex syntax representing the wrong set of strings.
Incompatible semantic representations such as string digits compared with integer values; failure to normalize interval bounds.
exclusion: Only the final message, marker, container or return shape is incorrect: C12.
Generic unsupported methods or operand types without a representation-specific cause: C03.
A missing unrelated eligibility filter: C05.

name: Incorrect ordering or selection priority
name_zh: 排序、择优规则或平局处理错误
definition: The program orders values or chooses a preferred candidate using the wrong direction, ranking key, key precedence or tie-breaking rule.
inclusion: Selecting first, smallest or most frequent when a different optimum is required.
Ignoring a secondary key, reversing requested output order, comparing only the last component of a lexicographic path.
Sorting positions that must remain in original order.
exclusion: A search never visits required candidates: C07.
A generic property proxy outside ordering or selection: C04.
A wrong key caused specifically by signed-digit interpretation: C10, without a redundant C11 label.

name: Incorrect result assembly or return contract
name_zh: 结果组装或返回形式不符合要求
definition: The returned result has the wrong structure, components, multiplicity, formatting or object kind, including incorrect placement of values in an assembled result.
inclusion: Missing separators or markers, malformed message substitution, wrong list/tuple/scalar/function return form.
Dropped or duplicated output elements, or incorrectly interleaved output components.
Returning a proxy object rather than the specified result representation.
exclusion: No completed return in an unfinished implementation: C01.
An incorrect numeric value alone: identify its mechanism instead.
Domain encoding or parsing transformations: C10; output ordering alone: C11.

name: Unhandled boundary or exceptional input
name_zh: 边界或异常输入处理缺失
definition: A valid boundary case or an explicitly specified invalid-input case bypasses necessary handling, producing an exception or a result contrary to that case's contract.
inclusion: Empty or all-filtered collections, zero-sized selection, zero/negative digit enumeration, equal operands.
Insufficient resources requiring saturation, or malformed inputs for which the contract requires a Boolean/sentinel.
A boundary guard that checks only the original collection rather than a derived empty collection.
exclusion: General indexing mistakes affecting ordinary traversal: C07.
Wrong recurrence base states: C08.
Do not assume a required behavior for inputs explicitly excluded by the task; record ambiguity where the domain is unclear.
